labels._title: One process versus separate services, and how each scales
labels._desc: Left: a monolithic application holding five modules in a single process, then replicated as the same process on four servers. Right: the same modules as separate services, then distributed across four servers, with some services replicated.
labels.c1:
A monolithic application puts all its
functionality into a single process...
labels.c2:
... and scales by replicating the
monolith on multiple servers
labels.c3:
A microservices architecture puts
each element of functionality into a
separate service...
labels.c4:
... and scales by distributing these services
across servers, replicating as needed.
